reuse.why: All actions, including the new setLastMonthSpending, go through the existing getBulkBudgetCategories and averageToBudget, but the #fixed rule reads a newly added category_groups.notes column instead of the notes table where group notes (NotesButton id={group.id}) are actually stored.

duplication.why: Exclusion rules are added once inside getBulkBudgetCategories; the only parallel structure is the new notes column shadowing the existing notes store.

placement.why: Rule placement in the shared selector is right, but adding a migration and schema field for group notes creates a second home for data the tree already keeps in the notes table.

scope.why: Includes a migration, AQL schema and DB type change the request did not need, plus an unrelated import reorder in schedules/app.ts.

maintainability.why: The selector stays a single point of truth, but the parallel notes column will never be filled by the UI, the '#fixed' check is a raw substring, and the dense combined condition is harder to read.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getBulkBudgetCategories in budget/actions.ts reads g.notes from a new category_groups.notes column (migration 1789000000000) instead of the existing notes table keyed by group id.

abstraction_drift.where: getBulkBudgetCategories swaps includeHidden for an optional includeHiddenCategories and absorbs the template and #fixed rules as general conditions; every month-wide action, including setLastMonthSpending, calls it.
